Definition: Does the government maintain a digital civil register?
Comments: Sudan’s Civil Registration Act (2011) defines a civil registry as an automated/computer record, and Landinfo reports implementation of a centralized electronic civil registry in 2011 replacing handwritten registers.

Definition: Is the register integrated with the national ID system?
Comments: Civil registration is the basis for issuing the unique national number and for issuance of national ID cards and passports; the ID card process uses the national number to retrieve the person from the civil registry database, indicating full integration.

Definition: Is the register integrated with the population register?
Comments: Sudan’s central civil registry database is described as a national database of individuals intended to be continuously updated with vital events, i.e., civil registration acts are the updating mechanism for the population database; thus civil register and population register are effectively unified/fully linked.

Definition: What proportion of land ownership does the register cover?
Comments: A UN Sudan land tenure thematic brief cites that only a very small minority of households hold official land registration certificates and references a UN-Habitat (2020) assessment that only 1% of agricultural land in Darfur is officially registered, supporting <20% coverage.
